title: Test-run history projection validates or traverses session rows under StateInner during summary snapshot builds
outcome: Test-run history projection validates or traverses session rows under StateInner during summary snapshot builds
acceptance: The cost of test_run_history_projection_locked's per-session validation or traversal under StateInner during a summary snapshot build is established from source and a measurement on a representative state; if it holds the lock for 100 ms or more, its session inputs are captured as immutable rows (through the existing cut owner from w-7e7cc49528b9) and the traversal runs after release.

Tests show the materialized test-run overview and history projection are equal to the current implementation's for representative states, including cache-hit, cache-miss and concurrent-mutation cases; no text-pinning test.
The independent review pair has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding and the full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
